proposedOperatorData.name: Adventure Parc Snowdonia
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Indoor and outdoor adventure hub in the Conwy Valley, at the gateway to Eryri
proposedOperatorData.description:
Adventure Parc Snowdonia sits in the Conwy Valley at Dolgarrog, backed by the Carneddau mountains on the edge of Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park. The site opened in 2015 as Surf Snowdonia, the world's first commercial artificial surfing lake, before rebranding in 2019 and later closing in 2023 due to wave-machine failures. It reopened in September 2025 under new owner Interesting Hotels Group as a land-and-air adventure centre, with the surf lagoon itself currently out of operation.

The reopened venue centres on Adrenaline Indoors: a ninja assault course with 9m and 12m freefall towers, a ten-route climbing wall, a high ropes course, a 100-metre underground caving maze, and freefall/drop experiences. Outdoors there is a zip line, pump track and skate bowl, pickleball courts, gorge walking, cycle hire, and hiking trails. On-site camping pods (sleeping four) and the Caffi Eryri restaurant (Wednesday to Sunday) round out the offer, and the operator also runs the nearby Ixora Hotel and Spa.

The venue holds Adventuremark accreditation and a Council for Learning Outside the Classroom (LOtC) Quality Badge, and is positioned for family days out, school trips, and corporate team-building.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: One of the few sites in Wales combining an indoor adrenaline complex (caving, climbing, ninja course, high ropes) with outdoor zip line, gorge walking and on-site camping pods, all within Eryri National Park.
